high_level_description: The image is a document from the Supreme Court of India, specifically a "Supplementary List" for a "Miscellaneous Hearing" on August 5, 2021. The document is structured with a formal header that includes the emblem of the Supreme Court of India and the names of the presiding judges: Hon'ble Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice Surya Kant. Emblem: The top of the document features the official emblem of the Supreme Court of India. Title: "SUPREME COURT OF INDIA" is prominently displayed. **
